title: nageia drouyniana
intro: Nageia drouyniana, commonly known as Drouyn's nut, is a species of coniferous tree in the family Podocarpaceae. It is native to Australia and is a type of evergreen tree that provides various health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Nageia drouyniana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Nageia drouyniana include sesquiterpenes, diterpenes, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
